name: Exposure Type 15 Code
definition: Specifies the underlying business area/type of trade causing the collateral movement.

BFWD.name: Bond Forward
BFWD.definition: Any securities traded out beyond 3 days which include treasury notes, Japanese Governement Bonds (JGBs) and Gilts.

PAYM.name: Cash Settlement
PAYM.definition: In support of any type of cash settlement.

CCPC.name: CCP Collateral
CCPC.definition: Collateral covering the initial margin requirements for OTC trades cleared through a CCP.

COMM.name: Commodities
COMM.definition: Any good exchanged during commerce, which includes goods traded on a commodity exchange.

CRDS.name: Credit Default Swap
CRDS.definition: Swap designed to transfer the credit exposure of fixed income products between parties.

CRTL.name: Credit Line
CRTL.definition: Opening of a credit line before trading.

CRSP.name: Credit Support
CRSP.definition: Cash lending/borrowing; letter of credit; signing of master agreement.

CCIR.name: Cross Currency IRS
CCIR.definition: Cross currency agreement between two parties (known as counterparties) where one stream of future interest payments is exchanged for another based on a specified principal amount.

CRPR.name: Cross Product
CRPR.definition: Combination of various types of trades.

EQPT.name: Equity Option
EQPT.definition: Trading of equity option (also known as stock options).

EXTD.name: Exchange Traded Derivatives
EXTD.definition: Trading of exchanged traded derivatives in general.

EQUS.name: Equity Swap
EQUS.definition: Equity swap trades where the return of an equity is exchanged for either a fixed or a floating rate of interest.

EXPT.name: Exotic Option
EXPT.definition: Trading of exotic option, for example, a non standard option.

FUTR.name: Futures
FUTR.definition: Agreement to buy or sell a specific amount of a commodity or financial instrument at a particular price on a stipulated future date.

OPTN.name: FX Option
OPTN.definition: A contract that grants the holder the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell currency at a specified exchange rate during a specified period of time.

LIQU.name: Liquidity
LIQU.definition: In support of settlement via an RTGS or other clearing system.

RVPO.name: Reverse Repurchase Agreement
RVPO.definition: In support of a reverse repurchase agreement transaction.

SLOA.name: Secured Loan
SLOA.definition: Exposure is linked to a secured loan.

SBSC.name: Securities Buy Sell Sell Buy Back

SCRP.name: Securities Cross Products
SCRP.definition: Combination of securities related exposure types.

SLEB.name: Securities Lending And Borrowing
SLEB.definition: Exposure is linked to a securities lending or borrowing activity.

SCIE.name: Single Currency IRS Exotic
SCIE.definition: Exotic single currency interest rate swap.

UDMS.name: Uncleared Derivative Margin Segregation
UDMS.definition: Relates to uncleared derivative margin segregation. This could be for variation or initial margin.

TRCP.name: Treasury Cross Product
TRCP.definition: Combination of treasury related exposure types.

CBCO.name: Central Bank Credit Operations
CBCO.definition: Exposures related to activity with central banks.
